story.titleZh: 安东内利赢得首届西班牙马德里赛道大奖赛，诺里斯进站失误失利好运
story.summaryZh: 安东内利在马德里赛道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛中夺冠，受益于诺里斯在第14圈虚拟安全车期间的进站失误，将冠军领先优势扩大至81分。
story.originalTitle: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli wins F1's first Madring race to increase title lead after Lando Norris misfortune
story.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli won the first Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring, benefiting from Lando Norris's pit-stop misfortune during a lap-14 Virtual Safety Car to extend his championship lead to 81 points.
detailZh: 西班牙大奖赛：基米·安东内利赢得F1首届马德里赛道比赛，在兰多·诺里斯遭遇不幸后扩大冠军领先优势
基米·安东内利以本赛季第八场胜利将冠军领先优势扩大至81分；兰多·诺里斯原本看似掌控比赛，却因不合时宜的虚拟安全车失去领先；马克斯·维斯塔潘第二，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿遭遇本赛季首次退赛
2026年西班牙大奖赛集锦
基米·安东内利在争夺2026年世界冠军的道路上再进一步，受益于兰多·诺里斯的进站不幸，赢得了在马德里赛道举行的首届西班牙大奖赛。
迈凯伦的诺里斯在将出色的杆位转化为比赛早期舒适领先后，原本看似掌控了比赛，但第14圈虚拟安全车的出现改变了胜利争夺，当时阿斯顿马丁的兰斯·斯特罗尔停在缓冲区。
虚拟安全车为全场提供了所谓“廉价”进站的机会，但迈凯伦无法立即让诺里斯进站，因为这位英国人刚刚驶过维修区入口道路。

但紧随其后的安东内利和维斯塔潘尚未通过，这使得梅赛德斯和红牛可以分别让他们的车手进站，而诺里斯则在赛道上以受控的降低速度行驶，同时马歇尔正在移动斯特罗尔的赛车。
迈凯伦确实在下一圈结束时让诺里斯进站，但那时虚拟安全车已经结束，意味着全场已恢复比赛速度，而这次不幸又因换胎时长达七秒的缓慢服务而雪上加霜。
兰多·诺里斯在一系列不幸事件后失去比赛领先，他在虚拟安全车期间错过了进站机会，随后迈凯伦又进行了一次非常缓慢的进站。
诺里斯以第五名重新加入比赛，并凭借惊人的速度最终以第三名紧追第二名的维斯塔潘，但在最后几圈中始终无法找到超越红牛的方法。
由于乔治·拉塞尔在第二辆梅赛德斯中仅获得第五名，落后于长时间领跑的查尔斯·勒克莱尔的法拉利，安东内利的冠军领先优势在剩余九场比赛的情况下扩大至赛季最高的81分。
安东内利说：“我认为今天获胜是好事，但感觉没那么好，因为我认为兰多今天配得上胜利，但总的来说，我们接受了。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在西班牙大奖赛被迫提前退赛
法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿现在落后101分，几乎退出争夺，因为他在赛车于七圈内遭遇致命刹车问题后，经历了本赛季首次退赛。
利亚姆·劳森为红牛获得第六名，阿尔派的弗兰科·科拉平托第七，领先于第二辆迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。小红牛的阿尔维德·林德布拉德第九，奥迪的尼科·霍肯伯格第十。
“我们太快了，仅此而已”——不走运的诺里斯的速度如何导致了他的不幸
在第14圈虚拟安全车启动之前，诺里斯似乎正准备重现他最近在匈牙利赛道和赞德福特的主导性胜利，他领先梅赛德斯的安东内利六秒。
这位卫冕世界冠军在比赛起步时受到冠军领先者的攻击，但安东内利很快陷入被动，因为他在刹车时切过了第一个减速弯。这让意大利人在出弯时取得领先，但他显然必须将位置交还给诺里斯，他迅速照做了。
基米·安东内利在西班牙大奖赛首圈两次跑宽
安东内利试图在接下来的五、六号减速弯再次从迈凯伦外侧绕过，但不得不再次放弃，又一次切过缓冲区。但当他第二次让诺里斯通过时，他无法阻止维斯塔潘也在七号弯跟进，因此跌至第三。
但安东内利很快又回到维斯塔潘前面，因为红牛告诉他们的车手退到意大利人和汉密尔顿后面，此前维斯塔潘在一号弯跑出赛道超越了后者。维斯塔潘在车队无线电中对这一事件解读提出异议，称他别无选择只能跑宽，但他服从了命令。
与此同时，诺里斯迅速开始建立领先优势，当维斯塔潘在第四圈退后时，他已经领先安东内利3.2秒。
兰多·诺里斯承认在错过关键的虚拟安全车进站后，车队“太快了”，这让他失去了比赛领先
这位英国人在第九圈时领先五秒，当虚拟安全车启动时，他的领先优势又扩大了一秒。最终，这种超凡的速度成为诺里斯的致命伤，因为他已经过了维修区入口，无法立即进站，而幸运的追赶者们则没有，因此可以进站。
赛后诺里斯在车队无线电中说：“只能接受。我们太快了，仅此而已。今天非常不走运，伙计们，我们本应该赢的。”
迈凯伦首席执行官扎克·布朗表示同意，他对天空体育 F1说：“那场比赛本属于我们，领先20或25秒。”
“他占据主导，他消失了。管理得当，轮胎磨损出色——独一档。”
现在冠军争夺中还有什么能阻止安东内利吗？
由于诺里斯在延迟且缓慢的进站后回到赛道时最初排在拉塞尔之后的第五位，随后梅赛德斯第二次进站，尽管还有40圈，安东内利的胜利似乎几乎不可避免。
然而，这位意大利人实际上直到第48圈结束才领先比赛，因为法拉利让勒克莱尔用硬胎留在外面，希望会有另一次虚拟或全场安全车干预。但没有出现。
基米·安东内利承认这不是他想要的获胜方式，兰多·诺里斯配得上西班牙大奖赛胜利
detailEn: Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli wins F1's first Madring race to increase title lead after Lando Norris misfortune

Kimi Antonelli increased his championship lead to a commanding 81 points with his eighth race win of the year; Lando Norris appeared to have race under control before untimely Virtual Safety Car lost him the lead; Max Verstappen second, while Lewis Hamilton suffered first DNF of his season
Highlights from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix
Kimi Antonelli took another step in his quest towards winning the 2026 world championship by benefitting from pit-stop misfortune for Lando Norris to win the first Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring.

McLaren's Norris had looked in control of the race after converting his superb pole position into a comfortable early race lead but the battle for victory turned on a lap-14 Virtual Safety Car when Aston Martin's Lance Stroll stopped in a run-off area.
With a VSC offering the field the chance of a so-called 'cheap' pit stop, McLaren were unable to pit Norris immediately as the Briton had just passed the pit-lane entry road.

But the following Antonelli and Verstappen had not, allowing Mercedes and Red Bull to pit their drivers respectively while Norris was running to a controlled reduced speed on track while marshals moved Stroll's car.

McLaren did pit Norris at the end of the next lap but, by then, the VSC had ended, meaning the field was back up to racing speed, with that misfortune then compounded by a slow seven-second service at the tyre change.
Lando Norris lost the race lead after an unlucky sequence of events which saw a missed a pitstop opportunity under a VSC, followed by a very slow stop by McLaren

Norris rejoined in fifth place and, underlining his prodigious pace, eventually finished on second-placed Verstappen's tail in third but was tantalisingly unable to find a way past the Red Bull through the closing laps.

With George Russell finishing only fifth in the second Mercedes behind a long-running Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, Antonelli's title lead grows to a season-high 81 points with a scheduled nine races remaining.
Antonelli said: "I think today it's good to win but it doesn't feel as good because I think Lando today deserved the win but overall, we take it."
Lewis Hamilton was forced to retire early at the Spanish Grand Prix
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton is now 101 points back and all but out of contention after he suffered his first race retirement of the season after his car ran into terminal brake issues inside seven laps.
Liam Lawson was sixth for Red Bull with Alpine's Franco Colapinto seventh ahead of Oscar Piastri in the second McLaren. Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad was ninth with Audi's Nico Hulkenberg in 10th.
'We were too quick, that's all it was' - How luckless Norris' speed led to his misfortune

Before the VSC was initiated on lap 14, Norris appeared to be shaping up for a repeat of his dominant recent wins at the Hungaroring and Zandvoort as he raced into a lead of six seconds over Mercedes' Antonelli.

The reigning world champion had come under attack from the championship leader at the race start but Antonelli was soon on the back foot when he cut the first chicane under braking. It put the Italian into the lead on the exit, but he clearly had to give the place back to Norris, which he swiftly did.
Kimi Antonelli found himself going wide twice on the opening lap of the Spanish Grand Prix

Antonelli attempted to go around the outside of the McLaren again into the next chicane at turns five-six but had to bail out of it once more, again cutting across the run-off. But when he let Norris through for a second time, he was unable to prevent Verstappen following through too at turn seven and so dropped to third.

But Antonelli was soon back ahead of Verstappen after Red Bull told their driver to drop back both behind the Italian and Hamilton having jumped the latter back at turn one by running off track. Verstappen disputed that interpretation of events over team radio, saying he had no choice but to run wide, but heeded the order.
Norris, meanwhile, had quickly set about building a lead and was already 3.2 ahead of Antonelli when Verstappen dropped back on lap four.
Lando Norris admits team 'were too quick' after missing a crucial VSC pit stop that cost him race lead

The Briton was five seconds clear by lap nine and his lead had grown the lead by a further second by the time the VSC was initiated. In the end, that supreme speed proved to be Norris' undoing, as he was already beyond the pit entry so could not pit immediately whereas his fortunate pursuers were not and so could.
Speaking on team radio after the race, Norris said: "Just take it on the chin. We were too quick, that's all. Very unlucky today guys, we should have won."
McLaren chief executive Zak Brown concurred, telling Sky Sports F1: "That was our race by 20 or 25 seconds.
"He was dominant, he was gone. Managing, great tyre wear - a league of his own."
Is there now any stopping Antonelli in the title chase?

With Norris returning to the track after his delayed and then slow stop initially behind Russell in fifth place before the Mercedes pitted for a second time, a victory for Antonelli appeared almost inevitable despite there still being 40 laps to go.

However, the Italian did not actually lead the race until the end of lap 48 as Ferrari kept Leclerc out on hard tyres in the hope of their being another Virtual or full Safety Car intervention. There was not.
Kimi Antonelli admitted it wasn't the way he wanted to win and that Lando Norris deserved the Spanish GP victory

Verstappen finished second, Leclerc fourth and Russell fifth; Hamilton retired inside seven laps with terminal brake issues, his first DNF of the season.
Antonelli said Norris deserved the win today but that he would take the result.

勒克莱尔表示，在圣保罗大奖赛的练习赛中经历了“最糟糕的感觉之一”后，他将对赛车做出“大幅”设定调整。
勒克莱尔在第二次练习赛中落后最快车手安东内利零点七秒，汉密尔顿则落后近半秒，法拉利在周五的速度不及梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛。
这与他们近期的表现形成反差，法拉利在最近四场比赛中都登上了领奖台，但勒克莱尔希望他们能在周六下午2点30分的第三次练习赛和下午6点的排位赛中扭转局面，天空体育F1频道将直播。

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."
Charles Leclerc says he's 'settled' feud with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton after their clash in last week's Mexico City GP

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their incident in Mexico
Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：安东内利在英特拉戈斯赛道以梅赛德斯赛车领跑，领先于升级后的迈凯伦车手诺里斯。

圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
